summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) for the title control; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, since the instructions prohibited running repository code; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
